description: DATA IS DATA, NOT STYLES. Reverse the prior task's decision to bake recovered presentation into the data layer: remove the per-cell CellStyle, per-row pitch, and total_styles/total_pitch carriers from sars.schema and stop sars.extract_data from populating them, so output/data/*.json holds ONLY report DATA - figures, names, ranks, counts, GPA, competency labels, and the structural grouping (column-header paths, colspans, section titles, which rows are totals). Presentation (fonts, sizes, colours, fills, row pitch) leaves the data entirely and becomes the responsibility of each report type's OWN self-contained template in FEAT-003. Deterministic, data-derived colour (the competency band) is NOT stored - it is computed by the template from the competency label / GPA via sars.competency. Keep the JSON round-trip lossless for the remaining (pure-data) fields, and keep the conversion path (`sars all`) untouched at 19/19 100%. Depends on FEAT-001; blocks FEAT-003.
steps: PRINCIPLE (user steering, authoritative): the extracted data must be DATA ONLY. Structure/grouping IS data (column-header label paths, colspan/rowspan grouping, section titles, totals-row identity, which report_type). Fonts, font sizes, text colours, background fill colours, and row pitch are NOT data - they are the report type's presentation and must not live in the schema or JSON.

In src/sars/schema.py: remove the CellStyle dataclass and every carrier the prior task added - the per-row `styles: dict[str, CellStyle]` and `pitch: float` fields on StudentRow, DivisionSummaryRow, PerformanceRow, SchoolRankRow, SubjectRankRow, TabularRow; and the `total_styles: dict[str, list[CellStyle]]` and `total_pitch: dict[str, float]` fields on SchoolsRankReport, SubjectsRankReport, TabularSection, GenericTabularReport. Also revert the `_coerce`/`_build`/`nested`/`SCHEMA_BY_TYPE` machinery that reconstructs CellStyle nesting on from_dict/from_json, so deserialisation no longer references CellStyle. Preserve all pure-DATA fields and the grouping fields (column_headers, colspan/span markers, section titles, totals maps).

In src/sars/extract_data.py: remove the style/geometry population helpers the prior task added (`_cell_style`, `_row_styles`, `_row_pitch`, `_group_cols`, `_group_data_rows_ctx`, `_total_rows_full`, `_group_total_styles`, and any pitch capture from model.Table.row_heights()) and stop threading styles/pitch onto the rows/totals/sections. The extractor still recovers the DATA and the STRUCTURE (grouped headers, colspans, totals) exactly as before - only the presentation capture is removed. Preserve every previously captured value (no data regression in template_audit).

Verify output/data/*.json now contains NO font/size/colour/background/pitch fields: after `sars data`, grep the JSON for `"background"`, `"size_pt"`, `"family"`, `"pitch"`, `"total_styles"`, `"total_pitch"`, `"styles"` and confirm none remain (competency values remain as plain text labels, not hex). Confirm `schema.from_dict(schema.to_dict(extracted))` still round-trips losslessly for the remaining data fields on MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK and at least one of each other family.

The templates currently CONSUME the removed carriers (base.styled_cell/competency_cell/TemplatePool, schools_rank._st/_data_row/_total_row/_summary_html, generic._section_table, subjects_rank, best_students, school_result_slip all read row.styles/row.pitch/report.total_styles). Do the MINIMUM here to keep the templated path importable and running after the schema change: make the templates render with pure data again (they may temporarily look like the pre-fidelity plain output). Full self-contained faithful styling is FEAT-003's job. It is acceptable for the templated compare images to look plain/unstyled at the end of THIS feature; what matters is (a) data JSON is pure data, (b) `sars template` runs without error, (c) no DATA/token regression.

Update tests in tests/test_sars.py that assert the styles-in-data design (search for CellStyle, `.styles`, `.pitch`, total_styles, total_pitch, and the renamed `test_competency_colour_is_not_fabricated_into_data_fields`). Restore/assert the DATA-IS-DATA invariant: the data schema/JSON carries NO font/size/colour/background/pitch fields, and the competency colour is NEVER stored (computed deterministically) - this realigns with the original `test_competency_colour_is_not_stored_as_data` intent. Keep the competency band-colour mapping tests (they test sars.competency, which stays).

Do NOT touch the conversion path (extract.py/classify.py/html_out.py/render.py) in this feature; `sars all` must still report 19/19 100%. The conversion path recovers presentation directly from model.Style at render time and never used the schema carriers, so it is unaffected.
Run `ruff check src tools` and `black --check src tools` and fix findings. Regenerate output/data via `sars data` so the pure-data JSON is current (FEAT-004 handles the other artefacts).
acceptance_criteria: sars.schema.py no longer defines CellStyle nor any styles/pitch/total_styles/total_pitch carrier; the schema dataclasses carry only DATA and STRUCTURE (grouping) fields.

sars.extract_data.py no longer captures or threads per-cell styles or per-row pitch; it still captures every DATA value and the structural grouping (grouped headers, colspans, totals) with no token/value regression.

output/data/*.json contains no `background`/`size_pt`/`family`/`pitch`/`styles`/`total_styles`/`total_pitch` keys; competency remains a text label; `schema.from_dict(schema.to_dict(extracted))` round-trips losslessly for the remaining fields.
The competency colour is not stored anywhere in the data (it is derived from the label/GPA by sars.competency).
`sars template` runs to completion for all 19 documents without error after the schema change (styling may be plain pending FEAT-003).
`python tools/template_audit.py` token completeness is no worse than the FEAT-001 baseline (data/values are unchanged).
`sars all` still reports `19/19 documents pass; mean text similarity 100.00%`.
`pytest -q` passes with the DATA-IS-DATA invariant tests; `ruff check src tools` and `black --check src tools` clean.
verification: . .venv/bin/activate && sars data && python -c "import glob,json; bad=[f for f in glob.glob('output/data/*.json') for k in ('background','size_pt','family','pitch','styles','total_styles','total_pitch') if k in open(f,encoding='utf-8').read()]; print('files with style keys:', len(set(bad))); assert not bad, sorted(set(bad))[:3]; print('DATA-IS-DATA OK')"

. .venv/bin/activate && python -c "import json; from sars import schema; d=json.load(open('output/data/MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK.json')); assert schema.to_dict(schema.from_dict(d))==d; print('round-trip OK')"
. .venv/bin/activate && ruff check src tools && black --check src tools

findings.summary: Reversed the prior task's decision to store presentation in the data layer. DATA IS DATA, NOT STYLES is now enforced: sars.schema carries only data + structure, sars.extract_data no longer captures any presentation, output/data/*.json is pure data, and all 7 templates render from pure data (competency colour derived deterministically, never stored). Conversion path (sars all) untouched at 19/19 100%.
findings.schema_changes: Removed the CellStyle dataclass entirely. Removed styles/pitch fields from StudentRow, DivisionSummaryRow, PerformanceRow, SchoolRankRow, SubjectRankRow, TabularRow. Removed total_styles/total_pitch from SchoolsRankReport, SubjectsRankReport, TabularSection, GenericTabularReport. Simplified _coerce (dropped the CellStyle entry and the dict[str, list[CellStyle]] branch); the nested-dataclass reconstruction for the remaining pure-data fields is unchanged. Updated the module docstring to state the DATA-IS-DATA principle.
findings.extract_data_changes: Removed the CellStyle import and the helpers _cell_style, _row_styles, _row_pitch, _group_total_styles, _group_data_rows_ctx, and _group_cols. _total_rows now collects values directly (dropped _total_rows_full which yielded styles+pitch). _student_from_row / _student_row / _full_capture / _performance_table / _extract_schools_rank / _extract_subjects_rank / _extract_generic / DivisionSummaryRow construction all stop threading styles/pitch. Every DATA value and the structural grouping (grouped headers, colspans, totals, sections, titles) are captured exactly as before - only presentation capture was removed. No use of model.Table.row_heights() remains in extract_data.
findings.template_changes: base.py dismantled the shared style plumbing that consumed the carriers: removed the DOC_CSS/StylePool import (now only MARGIN_PT), the TemplatePool wrapper, _to_style, _open_tag, and the pooled/inline style + pitch handling. styled_cell/cell/header_cell/competency_cell now render pure data (competency_cell derives its fill deterministically via sars.competency.background_for and never reads a stored colour). document_html no longer injects DOC_CSS or a pooled style block (TEMPLATE_CSS chrome only). schools_rank.py, generic.py, subjects_rank.py, best_students.py, best_students_subjectwise.py, school_result_slip.py all updated to call the pure-data helpers and no longer read row.styles/row.pitch/report.total_styles/total_pitch. NOTE: templated output is now intentionally plainer (FEAT-003 owns faithful per-report styling).
findings.token_completeness_fixes: Removing per-cell pitch/line-height reflowed rows so two adjacent cell values could overlap horizontally and be read as one PDF token, which initially dropped template_audit 'no value lost' from 4/19 to 3/19 (a rendering/layout artifact, not a data loss - the values remained in the pure-data JSON). Two style-free, structure-derived layout tweaks restored and improved it: (1) generic.render_generic renders reports with >20 columns (district_performance) in the dense 'compact' layout so wide totals rows do not overlap; (2) schools_rank._colgroup widens the C/RANK and R/RANK single-token columns from 2.0 to 4.5 so their nowrap captions stop overhanging into each other. Final template_audit: no value lost 5/19 (BETTER than the 4/19 FEAT-001 baseline; all 4 baseline-OK docs remain OK, plus Wards Rank). Mean document similarity 97.27% vs baseline 97.61% - the small dip is pagination reflow (fewer pages repeat the chrome header fewer times, lowering the raw token-overlap ratio), not lost data.
findings.test_changes: tests/test_sars.py: replaced test_competency_colour_is_not_fabricated_into_data_fields (which asserted recovered fills ARE carried in styles - now contradicts the steering) with test_competency_colour_is_not_stored_as_data (competency stays a text label, no hex in any data field) and added test_extracted_data_carries_no_presentation_fields (no schema dataclass declares styles/pitch/total_styles/total_pitch, CellStyle is gone, and the serialised JSON contains no background/size_pt/family/pitch/styles/total_styles/total_pitch keys). Kept the sars.competency band-colour mapping tests and the conversion-path test_rendered_html_preserves_original_styles (render_document / html_out is untouched and still carries recovered CSS).

verification_results.data_is_data: 0 files with style keys across output/data/*.json (checked background,size_pt,family,pitch,styles,total_styles,total_pitch); competency remains a text label (e.g. 'Grade A (Excellent)').
verification_results.round_trip: schema.to_dict(schema.from_dict(d)) == d for MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK and for all 19 output/data JSON files.
verification_results.sars_template: runs to completion for all 19 documents without error.
verification_results.template_audit: no value lost 5/19; pagination matches 4/19; mean document similarity 97.27% (baseline was 4/19 / 97.61%; the token-completeness metric improved, no data regression).
verification_results.sars_all: 19/19 documents pass; mean text similarity 100.00% (conversion path unchanged).
verification_results.pytest: 38 passed in ~88s (was 37; added one DATA-IS-DATA invariant test).
verification_results.ruff_black: ruff check src tools clean; black --check src tools clean (extract_data.py was reformatted by black and re-checked).

findings.notes: Conversion path files (extract.py/classify.py/html_out.py/render.py) were not touched; html_out.StylePool/DOC_CSS remain for the conversion path only. Regenerated output/data (pure data), output/template_html, output/template_pdf, output/html, output/pdf and the compare JPGs via sars data/template/all as part of verification; these are committed with the feature per the repo's committed-output convention.
